sixthsense.info.title: Guide
sixthsense.info.bow:
Bow
Warns of visible bow users within 24 blocks. Shows their number and whether they are drawing.
sixthsense.info.crossbow:
Crossbow
Tracks visible crossbow users within 24 blocks, including their loading state.
sixthsense.info.explosion:
Explosion
Detects visible Creepers and lit TNT within 24 blocks. TNT is also detected through walls. The shortest fuse takes priority.
sixthsense.info.ghast:
Ghast
Warns of visible Ghast attacks within 64 blocks and nearby fireballs. Distance labels are optional.
sixthsense.info.shulker:
Shulker
Counts Shulker bullets within 24 blocks, even behind walls.
sixthsense.info.warden:
Warden
Senses a Warden within 48 blocks, even behind walls. The heartbeat quickens as it approaches. A direction indicator and optional distance help you keep track.
sixthsense.info.thorns:
Thorns
Appear over one second when a Warden targets you, then react to its hits and your health. On vanilla servers, only confirmed Warden hits can be shown.
sixthsense.info.raid:
Raid
During a raid, locates the nearest raider within 128 blocks with its name, position and distance. Highlighting is optional.
sixthsense.info.layout:
Layout
The automatic row keeps the Warden centered. Custom positions stay anchored when the GUI scale changes.
sixthsense.info.editor:
HUD editor (H)
Drag to move an icon; use the wheel to resize it. G toggles the grid. R resets the selected icon, Shift+R resets all, and Esc saves.
sixthsense.info.debug:
Preview (D in the editor)
Hover over a card to play its animation. Includes the Phantom’s dive and recovery, and the bow’s crosshair markers. R does not reset anything here.
sixthsense.info.reload:
Reload images
Save your edited PNG files, then reload them from the editor. Invalid files keep their previous image.
sixthsense.info.settings:
Settings
Open from the H editor or Mod Menu. Uses Minecraft’s menu style. Special contains the experimental inner voice option, disabled by default. A position of -1 means automatic placement.
sixthsense.info.language:
Language
Follows Minecraft’s language setting. English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Simplified Chinese are supported. Other languages fall back to English.
sixthsense.info.general:
General
Warnings are off in Creative by default and hidden by F1, menus, death and Spectator mode. Some multiplayer warnings rely on estimates. Sixth Sense works in singleplayer and on servers with the mod installed.
sixthsense.technical.title: Settings
sixthsense.technical.enabled_help: Controls all warnings; previews stay available.
sixthsense.technical.creative_help: Show warnings in Creative mode. Off by default.
sixthsense.technical.phantom_help: Compact icon; width limited to 6–22 GUI pixels.
sixthsense.info.phantom:
Phantom
A nearby, unobstructed Phantom fades in over 0.8 seconds. Green eyes mean a dive; white eyes mean retreat. Wings fold as it approaches. Multiplayer dives are estimated.
sixthsense.config.grid_help: Show the grid and snap movable icons to it.
sixthsense.config.position_help: -1: automatic. Drag in H to anchor a position.
sixthsense.config.number_help: Range: %s–%s. Invalid values are not saved.
sixthsense.notice.multiplayer: Multiplayer warnings may be delayed or inaccurate.
sixthsense.config.aim_help: While drawing, corners show a predicted hit beyond 16 blocks. Arced targets below the crosshair can glow.
sixthsense.preset.help: Changes motion, opacity and distance labels; keeps positions and toggles.
sixthsense.config.reduced_motion_help: Removes shaking and pulsing from the Warden warning.
sixthsense.config.priority_help: Dims idle weapon warnings; active threats stay clear.
sixthsense.profile.failed: Profile could not be saved or restored.
sixthsense.info.aim:
Bow aim
While drawing, marks predict hits beyond 16 blocks on creatures, wooden buttons and End crystals. For curved shots, creatures below the crosshair can glow: red suggests a lethal hit, orange a tougher target. Damage is estimated.
sixthsense.sense.multiplayer: Sixth Sense also requires this mod on the server.

sixthsense.sense.started: I can see more clearly now.
sixthsense.info.sense:
Shift + H
Requires level 20 and no creature targeting you. Costs 109 XP, equivalent to levels 20–18. Reveals threats within 52 blocks for 60 seconds; the hotbar gauge shows time left. Hidden threats over 24 blocks below are excluded; open drops keep full range. Multiplayer requires the mod on both sides.
sixthsense.info.recovery:
Rest
Sleep through one night before using it again. Until then, staring at the sun strains your eyes and eventually makes you look down. Shade or a carved pumpkin protects them.
sixthsense.info.stealth:
Moving unseen
Detection range drops to 40%; movement is 10% faster. Hearing and retaliation still work. Sneak behind an unaware creature, jump and land a fully charged sword hit while falling for double damage.
sixthsense.info.presence:
Nearby threats
Threats appear as static silhouettes. Those that notice you become brighter and clearer. Afterward, a faint outline fades over five seconds.
sixthsense.info.voice:
Inner voice
Optional thoughts warn of hunger, eye strain and dangerous footing. The pixel sphere can reflect your skin’s eye color. Enable under Settings → Special; otherwise, only brief ability notices appear.
